name: Sharp Fine Cut Shredded Cheddar Cheese (Sargento)
ingredients_found: Cheddar Cheese [Pasteurized Milk, Cheese Culture, Salt, Enzymes, Annatto (Vegetable Color)], Potato Starch and Powdered Cellulose (to prevent caking), Natamycin (a natural mold inhibitor)
reason: Powdered cellulose + potato starch anti-caking agents (L3 gum/engineered filler) and natamycin preservative (L2). Annatto is a natural color and is allowed.
justification: Powdered cellulose and starch anti-cake coatings act as mucosal-stripping/undigested fillers on the cheese surface (Principle 1), and natamycin adds a synthetic-class mold inhibitor — disqualifying a shredded product versus the equivalent clean block.
notes: Classic shredded-cheese anti-cake matrix; buy the plain block instead.

name: Just Like Mature Cheddar Slices (Violife)
ingredients_found: Filtered water, coconut oil, food starch-modified (potato & corn), potato starch, sea salt, mature cheddar flavor (vegan), olive extract, beta carotene (color), vitamin B12
reason: Ultra-processed dairy-free analog built on modified food starch and refined starch fillers (L3 engineered isolates/thickeners); ~0g protein. Not a whole-food cheese.
justification: The product is a refined coconut-oil-and-starch emulsion with no intact protein matrix — the modified/engineered starches are exactly the undigested filler load the protocol filters out (Principles 1 & 5), delivering negligible bioavailable amino acids.
notes: Not real cheese; coconut oil itself is not a listed seed oil, but the modified food starch and 0g-protein UPF profile disqualify it.
